description: This file defines the 'PaymentService' interface, specifying methods related to payment processing, configuration, validation, and retrieval within an e-commerce system.
external_methods: processPayment(Customer customer, MerchantStore store, Payment payment, List<ShoppingCartItem> items, Order order)
processRefund(Order order, Customer customer, MerchantStore store, BigDecimal amount)
validateCreditCard(String number, CreditCardType creditCard, String month, String date)
processCapturePayment(Order order, Customer customer, MerchantStore store)

classes.name: PaymentService
classes.description: An interface defining payment-related operations for an e-commerce platform, including payment processing, configuration, validation, and retrieval.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getPaymentModulesConfigured
methods.description: Retrieves configured payment modules for a merchant store.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Processes a payment transaction for a customer shopping cart and order.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a specific order.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByType
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module based on the payment type (e.g., CREDITCARD).

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module based on a specific code, such as 'paypal' or 'authorizenet'.

methods.name: savePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the configuration for a specific payment module.

methods.name: validateCreditCard
methods.description: Validates the provided credit card details.

methods.name: getPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches the configuration for a given payment module.

methods.name: processCapturePayment
methods.description: Captures a payment for an order.

methods.name: getAcceptedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves a list of accepted payment methods for a store.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Returns a payment module based on its code.
